name: Pathfinder

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Waived for PenFed Honors Advantage Members (active military, Reserves, National Guard, honorably discharged veterans, retired military, OR primary owner on both credit card and a PenFed checking account - Access America Checking or Free Checking with $500 min balance or $500+ monthly direct deposits).

apr.notes: 17.99% variable APR based on creditworthiness; varies with Prime Rate. 0% introductory APR for 12 months on balance transfers made in first 60 days. Penalty APR applies if minimum payment not received within 60 days.

credit_required.notes: Credit score of 700+ generally recommended; PenFed membership required.

rewards.redemption_notes: Points valued at minimum $0.0085 each, up to $0.01. Redeem for travel, merchandise, and gift cards. Points expire 5 years from end of month earned. No limit on points earned. 4X travel / 3X dining for PenFed Honors Advantage Members.

signup_bonus.description: 50,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 in purchase transactions within the first 90 days of account opening (up to $500 in value).

benefits.title: Priority Pass Lounge Membership
benefits.description: Access over 1,200 VIP lounges worldwide with a complimentary annual Priority Pass Select membership, with an accompanying guest. Lounge visit fees apply.

benefits.title: Global Entry Statement Credit
benefits.description: $120 statement credit towards Global Entry every 4 years when you charge the program fee to your card.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck Statement Credit
benefits.description: $85 statement credit towards TSA PreCheck every 4 years when you charge the program fee to your card.

benefits.title: Airline Ancillary Travel Statement Credit
benefits.description: Statement credits up to $100 per calendar year toward incidental air travel fees such as baggage fees, flight-change fees, in-flight food and beverage, airport lounge day-passes.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Automatic protection for physical damage, theft, reasonable and customary towing, and loss-of-use charges when renting with the card.

benefits.title: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Covers up to $300 per purchased ticket for reasonable expenses incurred when delayed for more than 12 hours.

benefits.title: Complimentary Concierge Service
benefits.description: Visa concierge service available 24/7, 365 days a year for travel, dining, and entertainment needs.

benefits.title: Access to Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to luxury hotels around the world with premium offers and discounts.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Protect your cell phone against theft and damage by paying your monthly wireless bill with your PenFed credit card.

lounge_access.notes: Complimentary annual membership; access to 1,200+ VIP lounges worldwide; accompanying guest included; lounge visit fees apply

other: $100 annual airline ancillary travel statement credit
Trip Delay Reimbursement up to $300 per ticket

notes: Visa Signature. Annual fee $95, waived for PenFed Honors Advantage Members. No foreign transaction fees. Priority Pass Select membership included.
